title: Member migration (#migrate)
summary: ConvRulesEditor: write #migrate Old -> New or -> DL_NONE (one row, or DL_NONE for all selected rows) into the row's book, or via the block's Members list
intro: Replace a member the converted code still uses (rename it, or mark it DL_NONE to convert by hand later) without typing the rule; the line goes into the book that converted the row (pas_uses[].rules_file); needs an engine with migrate_members.
